name: cr1000a-mcp
description: See who is on your Verizon CR1000A (Fios) router, its WAN status, DNS records and port forwards. Optional write tools.
long_description: Talks to your CR1000A over your local network through the router's own web interface. Read tools: router status, known devices, bandwidth and per-device traffic, DNS records, port forwards, IPv6 pinholes and a few data pages. Write tools (add or remove DNS records, port forwards and IPv6 pinholes) are off until you switch on "Allow changes". Secret-looking fields from the router are redacted. Unofficial: it uses the router's undocumented web API, verified on firmware 3.6.0.5_BD.

tools.name: router_status
tools.description: Uptime, WAN IPv4/IPv6 and WAN DNS servers

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Devices the router knows about, with filtering and a short default field set

tools.name: get_router_page
tools.description: One allowlisted data page (arp, net_connections, log, upnp, firmware); secrets redacted

tools.name: add_dns_record
tools.description: Add a local IPv4 DNS record (needs Allow changes)

tools.name: remove_dns_record
tools.description: Remove a local IPv4 DNS record (needs Allow changes)

tools.name: remove_dns_record_v6
tools.description: Remove a local IPv6 DNS record (needs Allow changes)

tools.name: add_port_forward
tools.description: Add a port forward, which opens a port to the internet (needs Allow changes)

tools.name: remove_port_forward
tools.description: Remove a port forward (needs Allow changes)

tools.name: add_ipv6_pinhole
tools.description: Open an inbound IPv6 pinhole (needs Allow changes)

tools.name: remove_ipv6_pinhole
tools.description: Remove an IPv6 pinhole (needs Allow changes)

router_ip.title: Router IP address
router_ip.description: Address of your CR1000A on your home network. The default is correct for most Verizon routers.

network_settings_password.title: Network Settings Password
network_settings_password.description: Printed on the sticker on the back of the router (label: Network Settings Password).

allow_changes.title: Allow changes
allow_changes.description: Switch on to let the assistant add or remove DNS records, port forwards and IPv6 pinholes. Leave off for read-only access.
